notes.title: Tablets of Power - Monitor Resizing & Controller Support Update!
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers!

We’re excited to roll out a brand-new update for Tablets of Power that enhances your gaming experience with seamless monitor resizing and full controller support! Whether you’re swapping screens or grabbing a gamepad, this update has you covered. Let’s dive into what’s new!

[b]What’s New in This Update:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Dynamic Monitor Resizing:[/b] Now, when you move the game to a different monitor, Tablets of Power automatically adjusts to the new resolution, ensuring crisp visuals and proper scaling. Perfect for multi-monitor setups!

[list]
[*][b]How to Switch Monitors:[/b] Press [b]WinKey + Shift + Left [/b]or [b]WinKey + Shift + Right[/b] to move the game window between monitors. The game will resize instantly to match the new screen’s resolution, whether it’s bigger or smaller.[/list][/list]
[b]Full Controller Support:[/b] Play with any XInput-compatible controller alongside keyboard controls. Here’s the rundown:
[list]
[*][b]Action/Select:[/b] Press B, Space, or Enter to talk to NPCs, open chests, pick up items, or find hidden treasures.
[*][b]Back/Cancel:[/b] Use A or Escape to navigate back or cancel selections.
[*][b]Menu:[/b] Access the menu with Y, F1, or Escape for quick inventory and party management.
[*][b]Toggle Active Party:[/b] When available, switch your lead character with X.
[*][b]Page Through Options:[/b] Cycle through menus or options using Left Trigger and Right Trigger when available.
[*][b]Pause:[/b] Hit Start or P to pause the game and catch your breath.
[*][b]Movement:[/b] Use the left stick or arrow keys—hold longer to speed up!
[/list]
[b]Improved Input Handling:[/b] Our input system now detects controllers dynamically, letting you plug and play or switch between keyboard and controller mid-game without a hitch.

This update is all about flexibility and polish, inspired by your feedback. Whether you’re tweaking your setup across multiple monitors or settling in with a controller, Tablets of Power feels better than ever. If you run into any issues, drop by the Steam Discussions page to let us know or you can contact me at support@tabletsofpower.com.


[b]How to Get Started:[/b]
Update Tablets of Power to the latest version via Steam.

Try moving the game window with WinKey + Shift + Left/Right to test the new resizing feature on your monitors.

Connect a controller and check out the updated controls in-game.

Thank you for adventuring with us.
Now, switch those monitors, grab your controller, and lead your party to glory!
Happy adventuring,
D!

notes.title: Updates for March 24th
notes.content:
Updated character portraits
New Game Icon
Added save spots in the battle of Garoar
Changed battle against Lord Burnschild and Goros to be a little 'easier'
Updated Sprite Sheets for non-main party members to include Sleep
William's War Cry skill no longer checks for MP

notes.title: Update Notes for March 4th
notes.content: Based on your feedback, we’ve added a handy option to the start screen: you can now transfer your saved data between devices! Easily switch from desktop to phone or move your progress from an old device to a new one. Thanks for helping us make the game even better—happy playing!

notes.title: Update Notes for Fed 15th
notes.content:
We've worked on some additional features and tweaks and fixes from feedback.

- Added Smoke Bomb item available in the Neko shop ([i]disables random battles for 50 steps, the item can be stacked. Steps left shows in config screen[/i])
- Added to show if character has item equipped in shop screen
- Added more chests and save spots in various maps
- Added additional hot keys.  (P) for Pause at any time and (A) for Auto toggle in battle screen.
- Adjusted prices on Ball purchases
- Better balanced battles with more monster effect abilities added
- Balanced magic when using ALL
- Fixed various minor glitches, visual affects and typos
- Fixed Optimize equipment to include only equipment the character can carry

notes.title: Update Notes for Jan 30th
notes.content: Based on player feedback, we've revamped our game's presentation by ditching the lower resolution fullscreen mode for a sleeker borderless/windowed fullscreen feature. Very pleased with this update as it aligns perfectly with our original intended aspect ratio and also keeps your screen resolution intact without changing to a lower resolution. Enjoy the seamless experience!
